title: Senior Backend Engineer
description_text:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and build scalable APIs powering millions of users. You will work closely with product and infrastructure teams to deliver high-quality software.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement RESTful and gRPC APIs using Python and FastAPI
- Own backend services from design through deployment
- Collaborate with the data team on PostgreSQL schemas and query optimization
- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response

Requirements:
- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python
- Experience with FastAPI or similar async frameworks
- Proficiency with PostgreSQL or other relational databases
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Solid understanding of distributed systems
requirements: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
Experience with FastAPI or similar async frameworks
Proficiency with PostgreSQL or other relational databases
nice_to_have: Familiarity with Kafka or other message queues
Prior experience at a high-growth startup

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description_text:
Join our AI Platform team to build and scale machine learning infrastructure. You will work on model training pipelines, feature stores, and model serving systems that power our core product.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain ML training pipelines using Python and PyTorch
- Develop feature engineering and data preprocessing workflows
- Deploy and monitor models in production using MLflow and AWS SageMaker
- Collaborate with research scientists to move experiments to production

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in machine learning engineering
- Proficiency in Python and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Familiarity with MLOps practices and tooling
- Strong understanding of data pipelines and ETL processes
requirements: Proficiency in Python and PyTorch or TensorFlow
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure
Experience with data pipelines and ETL

title: Full Stack Engineer
description_text:
BuildFast is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build features across our React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend. You'll own features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of full-stack experience
- Proficiency in React and TypeScript
- Backend experience with Python (FastAPI or Django)
- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL)
- Comfortable with Git and CI/CD workflows
requirements: Backend experience with Python (FastAPI or Django)
